title: Acute Coronary Syndrome and the BC Chest Pain Protocol
next: Chapter 30, Lesson 3: Heart failure, CPAP, cardiogenic shock and aortic emergencies

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already run the BC chest pain protocol: oxygen, ASA, nitro, Entonox. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Follow the disease from plaque to clot to heart attack
  2. Recognize ACS, including atypical and silent cases
  3. Apply the exact ASA and nitro rules, plus what the PCP adds

Textbook: Chapter 30, PDF pages 2582–2599
slides.say: Welcome back. In BC, chest pain is a protocol you already run as an EMR: oxygen if needed, ASA, nitroglycerin, and Entonox when nitro isn't enough. So today isn't about learning those drugs from zero; it's about running the whole call like a PCP. First, we'll follow the disease from a fatty plaque to a clot to a heart attack, because that explains why one drug saves lives and another doesn't. Second, we'll recognize acute coronary syndrome, including patients with no chest pain at all. Third, we'll go through the exact BC rules for ASA and nitro, and what the PCP adds.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。在 BC，胸痛流程是你当 EMR 时就在用的：需要时给氧、ASA、硝酸甘油，硝酸甘油不够时用 Entonox（笑气）。所以今天不是从零学这些药，而是学怎样像 PCP 一样把整个呼叫跑下来。第一，跟着疾病从脂肪斑块走到血栓、再到心梗，因为这能解释为什么一种药救命、另一种不救命；第二，识别急性冠脉综合征，包括完全没有胸痛的病人；第三，逐条过一遍 BC 的 ASA 和硝酸甘油规则，以及 PCP 多做什么。

slides.title: From plaque to clot
slides.body:
Fatty streak→Atheroma→Hard plaque→Rupture + clot
  • Slow narrowing → stable angina, leg pain on walking
  • Sudden rupture + clot → heart attack (MI)
  • Also behind heart failure, aneurysm, dissection, stroke

Risk factors you'll hear: high BP, smoking, diabetes, cholesterol, inactivity, obesity, family history.
slides.say: It starts with atherosclerosis: fatty material builds up inside the artery wall, probably from childhood, and the wall becomes inflamed and thick. A fatty streak grows into a fatty lump called an atheroma, which hardens into a plaque. A plaque hurts the patient in two ways. Slowly, it narrows the artery, so the muscle runs short of blood during effort: stable angina in the heart, or leg cramps when walking. Or suddenly, the plaque cracks, a clot forms on the rough surface, and the artery blocks: a heart attack. The same disease is behind heart failure, aortic aneurysm and dissection, and stroke.
slides.sayZh: 一切从动脉粥样硬化开始：脂质在动脉壁内沉积，大概从童年就开始了，管壁发炎、增厚。脂纹长成一团叫粥样瘤的脂肪块，再硬化成斑块。斑块伤人有两种方式：一是慢慢把动脉变窄，用力时肌肉供血不够——在心脏就是稳定型心绞痛，在腿上就是走路时小腿抽痛；二是斑块突然破裂，粗糙的表面上形成血栓，把动脉堵死——这就是心梗。同一种病还是心衰、主动脉瘤和夹层、卒中的根源。

slides.title: Stable angina or something worse?
slides.body:
Stable anginaUnstable angina
TriggerPredictable effortLess effort, or at rest
PatternSame every timeMore often, more severe
DurationMinutes; rest or nitro relieves> 15 minutes
MeaningFixed narrowingPlaque rupture: ACS

On scene you can't tell angina from a heart attack: treat as ACS.
slides.say: Angina is chest pain when the heart muscle needs more oxygen than a narrowed artery can deliver. Stable angina is predictable: the same hill brings the same squeezing pain, and rest or the patient's own nitro relieves it within a few minutes. Unstable angina comes more often, gets worse, lasts more than fifteen minutes, or starts at rest. That change suggests a ruptured plaque, and a heart attack may follow, so it belongs to acute coronary syndrome. The field rule: you can't tell angina from a heart attack on scene, so treat possible ischemia as ACS.
slides.sayZh: 心绞痛是心肌需要的氧多于狭窄动脉能送到的量时出现的胸痛。稳定型心绞痛可以预测：爬同一个坡就出现同样的压榨痛，休息或含服自己的硝酸甘油几分钟内缓解。不稳定型心绞痛发作更频繁、更重、超过十五分钟，或在休息时发作。这种变化提示斑块破裂，随后可能心梗，所以它属于急性冠脉综合征。现场规则：你在现场分不清心绞痛和心梗，所以凡疑似缺血，一律按 ACS 处理。

slides.title: The ACS spectrum
slides.body:
Unstable anginamuscle starved, not dyingblood markers normal
NSTEMImuscle dyingno ST elevation; markers up
STEMImuscle dyingST elevation on the 12-lead

A 12-lead can rule in STEMI, never rule out ACS. 90% of AMI deaths are dysrhythmias, mostly early VF.
slides.say: Acute coronary syndrome, or ACS, is a spectrum caused by a ruptured plaque and a clot. At one end is unstable angina: the muscle is starved but not dying, and hospital blood tests stay normal. Next is NSTEMI, a heart attack without ST elevation; muscle is dying, so the blood markers rise. At the far end is STEMI, with ST elevation on the twelve-lead ECG. The history is the same for all three, so a twelve-lead can rule a STEMI in, but never rule ACS out. And ninety percent of heart attack deaths come from rhythm problems, mostly ventricular fibrillation in the early hours, so keep the defibrillator close.
slides.sayZh: 急性冠脉综合征（ACS）是由斑块破裂加血栓引起的一个连续谱。一端是不稳定型心绞痛：心肌缺血但还没坏死，医院的血液检查正常。中间是 NSTEMI，没有 ST 段抬高的心梗：心肌在坏死，血液标志物升高。另一端是 STEMI，十二导联心电图上有 ST 段抬高。三者病史一样，所以十二导联能确认 STEMI，却永远不能排除 ACS。心梗死亡有百分之九十是心律失常造成的，多数是早期几小时内的室颤，所以除颤器要放在手边。

slides.title: What ACS usually looks like
slides.body:
• Under the sternum or left chest: pressure, heavy, squeezing
  • Lasts > 15 minutes; clenched fist (Levine sign)
  • Spreads to arm in 25%; right arm strongly suggests cardiac
  • Neck, jaw, upper back, upper abdomen
  • Not changed by breathing, coughing or moving
  • Sweating, breathlessness, nausea, weakness, sense of doom
slides.say: Here's the typical picture. The discomfort sits under the breastbone or on the left side of the chest: heavy, squeezing, crushing, or tight. Many patients say pressure, not pain, so ask about discomfort too. It usually lasts more than fifteen minutes, and some make a fist over the chest as they describe it; that's the Levine sign. In about a quarter of cases it spreads to the arms, usually the left, but right-arm pain strongly suggests the heart. It can also reach the neck, jaw, upper back, or upper abdomen, and breathing or moving doesn't change it. Look for sweating, breathlessness, nausea, weakness, and a sense of doom.
slides.sayZh: 典型表现是这样的：不适在胸骨后或左胸，沉重、压榨、碾压或发紧。很多病人说是「压着」而不是「痛」，所以也要问有没有不适。通常持续超过十五分钟，有人描述时会在胸前握拳，这叫 Levine 征。约四分之一会放射到手臂，多为左臂，但右臂痛强烈提示心源性。也可放射到颈部、下颌、上背或上腹，呼吸和活动都不改变它。还要看有没有出汗、气促、恶心、乏力和濒死感。

slides.title: Atypical and silent heart attacks
slides.body:
10–20% of heart attacks have no chest pain

  • Diabetics, older people, heart transplant patients
  • Instead: sudden breathlessness, low BP, confusion, exhaustion
  • Women: nausea, light-headedness, epigastric burning, fatigue
  • Own nitro failed? Ask about burning, flushing, headache
slides.say: Now the patients who fool us. Ten to twenty percent of heart attacks come with no chest pain at all. This silent MI is common in diabetics, older adults, and heart transplant patients, who may present instead with sudden breathlessness, low blood pressure, confusion, or exhaustion. Women more often have nausea, light-headedness, upper abdominal burning, weakness, or fatigue, and heart disease causes one in three female deaths in Canada. One more clue: if the patient's own nitro didn't help, ask whether they felt the usual burning under the tongue, flushing, or headache. If they did, the pills work, and something serious is going on.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲最容易骗过我们的病人。百分之十到二十的心梗完全没有胸痛。这种无痛性心梗常见于糖尿病人、老年人和心脏移植病人，他们可能表现为突然气促、低血压、意识混乱或极度疲乏。女性更常出现恶心、头晕、上腹烧灼感、无力或乏力；在加拿大，女性死亡有三分之一是心脏病造成的。还有一条线索：病人自己的硝酸甘油不管用时，问他有没有感到平时那种舌下灼热、脸红或头痛。如果有，说明药是有效的，那就是病情严重。

slides.q: A 72-year-old woman with diabetes has felt weak, nauseated and short of breath since morning. No chest pain. She is pale and sweaty. BP 146/88, HR 96. No allergies, no bleeding problems. Which statement is correct?
options: No chest pain, so ACS is unlikely
Treat as possible ACS: BC allows ASA for atypical symptoms consistent with cardiac ischemia
Give nitroglycerin first, because it is the life-saving drug
Wait for a 12-lead ECG to rule out ACS before treating
slides.say: Let's pause for a question. A seventy-two-year-old woman with diabetes has felt weak, nauseated, and short of breath since this morning, with no chest pain. She's pale and sweaty; blood pressure one hundred forty-six over eighty-eight, heart rate ninety-six. Which statement is correct? A, no chest pain, so ACS is unlikely. B, treat as possible ACS: BC allows ASA for atypical symptoms consistent with cardiac ischemia. C, give nitroglycerin first, because it's the life-saving drug. D, wait for a twelve-lead ECG to rule out ACS before treating. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 停一下考考你。一位七十二岁的糖尿病女性，从早上起感到乏力、恶心、气促，没有胸痛。她面色苍白、出汗；血压一百四十六比八十八，心率九十六。哪种说法正确？A 没有胸痛，所以不太可能是 ACS；B 按可能的 ACS 处理：BC 允许对符合心肌缺血的不典型症状给 ASA；C 先给硝酸甘油，因为它是救命药；D 等十二导联心电图排除 ACS 后再处理。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. Older women with diabetes often have heart attacks without chest pain, and the BC ASA monograph covers atypical symptoms consistent with cardiac ischemia. A ignores silent MI. C is wrong twice: ASA is the life-saving drug, and the BC nitro indication is chest discomfort that appears cardiac. D is wrong because a twelve-lead can confirm a STEMI, but never rule out ACS.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。患糖尿病的老年女性常发生无胸痛心梗，而 BC 的 ASA 药物专论适应症包括符合心肌缺血的不典型症状。A 忽视了无痛性心梗。C 错了两处：救命药是 ASA，而且 BC 硝酸甘油的适应症是看起来是心源性的胸部不适。D 错，十二导联能确认 STEMI，但永远不能排除 ACS。

slides.title: ASA: the life-saving drug
slides.body:
BC dose: 160 mg PO, chewed and swallowed

  • Not if: can't swallow, allergy, active ulcer or GI bleeding
  • Not if: already took the dose before you arrived
  • Not if: asthma from ASA/NSAIDs; child with viral symptoms
  • Caution: bleeding risk, blood thinners, recent surgery, pregnancy
  • No vitals needed first; give after the rapid body survey
slides.say: ASA, or acetylsalicylic acid, stops platelets clumping into a clot, and it dramatically cuts heart attack deaths: it's the life-saving drug of ACS. The BC dose is one hundred sixty milligrams by mouth, chewed and swallowed; it works in twenty minutes to an hour. Don't give it if the patient can't swallow, is allergic, has an active ulcer or stomach bleeding, already took the dose before you arrived, has asthma triggered by ASA or anti-inflammatories, or is a child with viral symptoms. Be cautious with bleeding risk, blood thinners, recent surgery, or possible pregnancy. And it's the only BC drug that doesn't need vitals first.
slides.sayZh: ASA（乙酰水杨酸）阻止血小板聚集成血栓，能大幅降低心梗死亡率，它是 ACS 的救命药。BC 剂量是一百六十毫克口服，嚼碎咽下，二十分钟到一小时起效。以下情况不给：不能吞咽、过敏、活动性溃疡或消化道出血、你到场前已服过该剂量、有 ASA 或消炎止痛药诱发的哮喘、有病毒感染症状的儿童。有出血风险、在用抗凝药、近期手术或可能怀孕时要慎用。它也是 BC 唯一一种给药前不要求先测生命体征的药。

slides.title: Nitroglycerin: the BC rules
slides.body:
• No nitro if systolic < 110 or nitrate allergy
  • No nitro if heart rate < 50 or > 150
  • No nitro after Viagra or Levitra in 24 h, or Cialis in 48 h
  • Dose: 0.4 mg SL every 3–5 min while systolic stays > 110
  • Max 3 doses in any 30 min; the patient's own doses don't count
  • Works in 60 seconds, lasts 30 minutes; don't shake the spray
slides.say: You already give nitro; as a PCP, know its rules exactly. Don't give it if the systolic is below one hundred ten, if the patient is allergic to nitrates, or if the heart rate is below fifty or above one hundred fifty. Don't give it after Viagra or Levitra in the past twenty-four hours, or Cialis in the past forty-eight, because together they can crash the blood pressure. The dose is zero point four milligrams under the tongue every three to five minutes, while the systolic stays above one hundred ten, until the pain is gone. The maximum is three doses in any thirty minutes, whatever the patient took before you arrived.
slides.sayZh: 硝酸甘油你已经在用；作为 PCP，规则要记得一字不差。收缩压低于一百一十、对硝酸酯过敏、心率低于五十或高于一百五十，都不能给。过去二十四小时内用过万艾可（Viagra）或艾力达（Levitra），或过去四十八小时内用过希爱力（Cialis），也不能给，因为合用会让血压骤降。剂量是零点四毫克舌下，每三到五分钟一次，只要收缩压保持在一百一十以上，一直给到不痛为止。任意三十分钟内最多三次，不管病人到场前自己用了多少。

slides.title: Why nitro is not the life-saver
slides.body:
• Opens veins (less preload) and arteries (less afterload)
  • Widens coronary arteries: relieves angina fast
  • Can't dissolve a clot; doesn't lower AMI deaths
  • Expect low BP, especially in the elderly: no walking, prevent falls
  • Inferior MI may involve the right ventricle: very preload-sensitive

BC: start transport after the first dose. Nitro never delays transport.
slides.say: Why isn't nitro the life-saver? It relaxes the veins, so less blood returns to the heart, lowering preload; at higher doses it relaxes the arteries, lowering afterload. It also widens the coronary arteries, so it relieves angina fast. But it can't open an artery blocked by a clot, and it doesn't reduce heart attack deaths. So it must never delay transport; BC says start transport after the first dose. Expect low blood pressure, especially in older patients, so keep them seated or lying down. And an inferior heart attack may involve the right ventricle, which depends on preload; the textbook lists a known right ventricular infarct as a contraindication.
slides.sayZh: 为什么硝酸甘油不是救命药？它让静脉松弛，回心血减少，降低前负荷；剂量大时让动脉松弛，降低后负荷。它还能扩张冠状动脉，所以缓解心绞痛很快。但它打不开被血栓堵住的动脉，也不降低心梗死亡率。所以它绝不能耽误转运；BC 规定给完第一剂就出发。要预料到血压会下降，老年人尤其如此，让病人坐着或躺着。还有，下壁心梗可能累及依赖前负荷的右心室，教材把已知的右室梗死列为禁忌。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: the BC chest pain protocol
slides.body:
BC Cardiac Chest Pain protocol: presentation suggestive of cardiac chest pain

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Position of comfort; limit movement
  • O₂ to keep SpO₂ ≥ 94%
  • ASA chewed and swallowed, if not already taken
  • Start transport now; crew preps the exit
  • History, pain assessment, baseline vitals
  • Nitro if appropriate; Entonox if nitro fails

PCP adds

  • Vascular access with running IV fluid
  • Consider dimenhydrinate for nausea

Entonox: pain after 3 nitro, or systolic < 110 → start 5 min after the last nitro. Vitals every 5 min.
slides.say: Here's the BC chest pain protocol; notice how much you already do. On the left, every licence level: position of comfort with limited movement, oxygen to keep the saturation at ninety-four or higher, ASA chewed and swallowed if not already taken, transport started right away while crew members prepare the exit, a history with pain assessment and baseline vitals, and nitro if appropriate. If pain continues after three doses of nitro, or the systolic falls below one hundred ten, give Entonox five minutes after the last nitro. On the right, the PCP adds two items: vascular access with running IV fluid, and dimenhydrinate, or Gravol, for nausea.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 的胸痛流程，留意有多少是你已经在做的。左栏，所有执照级别：舒适体位、减少活动；给氧使血氧维持在九十四以上；如果还没吃过，给 ASA 嚼服咽下；立即启动转运，其他队员准备撤离通道；采集病史、疼痛评估和基线生命体征；合适时给硝酸甘油。三剂硝酸甘油后仍痛，或收缩压降到一百一十以下，在最后一剂硝酸甘油五分钟后给 Entonox。右栏，PCP 多两项：建立静脉通路并保持输液通畅；恶心时考虑茶苯海明（Gravol）。

slides.q: A 58-year-old man has crushing chest pain. BP 132/84, HR 88. He chewed ASA before you arrived. He took Cialis (tadalafil) 30 hours ago. You are the PCP. What is your best plan?
options: Give nitro 0.4 mg SL: more than 24 hours have passed
No nitro; start transport, start the IV en route, consider Entonox
Give a half dose of nitro and watch the BP
Stay on scene until the IV is running, then give nitro
slides.say: Let's try a PCP decision. A fifty-eight-year-old man has crushing chest pain; blood pressure one hundred thirty-two over eighty-four, heart rate eighty-eight. He chewed ASA before you arrived, and he took Cialis thirty hours ago. You're the PCP. What's your best plan? A, give nitro zero point four milligrams under the tongue, because more than twenty-four hours have passed. B, no nitro; start transport, start the IV en route, and consider Entonox. C, give a half dose of nitro and watch the blood pressure. D, stay on scene until the IV is running, then give nitro. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。一位五十八岁男性，压榨性胸痛；血压一百三十二比八十四，心率八十八。你到场前他已经嚼服了 ASA，三十小时前还服过希爱力（Cialis）。你是 PCP，最好的方案是什么？A 舌下给硝酸甘油零点四毫克，因为已经超过二十四小时；B 不给硝酸甘油，启动转运，途中开静脉，考虑 Entonox；C 给半剂量硝酸甘油并观察血压；D 留在现场等静脉通路建好再给硝酸甘油。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. In BC, Cialis within forty-eight hours rules out nitro; the twenty-four-hour limit is only for Viagra and Levitra. BC lists Entonox for cardiac chest pain when nitro is contraindicated, and you start the IV on the way. A uses the wrong time limit. C is wrong: BC has no half dose, and the contraindication stands. D delays transport for an IV that doesn't change the nitro decision.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。在 BC，四十八小时内用过希爱力就不能给硝酸甘油；二十四小时的界限只适用于万艾可和艾力达。BC 把 Entonox 列为硝酸甘油禁忌时心源性胸痛的用药，静脉通路你在途中建立。A 用错了时间界限；C 错，BC 没有半剂量，禁忌照样成立；D 为了一条不改变硝酸甘油决定的静脉通路耽误了转运。

slides.title: Reperfusion: time is muscle
slides.body:
• Goal: reopen the artery fast; every minute costs muscle
  • PCI (balloon): preferred within 90–120 min of first medical contact
  • First medical contact can be you
  • Fibrinolytics: dissolve the clot; bleeding risk; not on the BC exam list
  • Book: early 12-lead + early notice cut 15–30 min
  • Book: repeat a normal 12-lead before leaving: +10–15% STEMIs
slides.say: The textbook's motto is time is muscle: the longer a clot blocks the artery, the less muscle survives. Hospitals reopen it in two ways. PCI, a balloon on a catheter, is preferred if done within ninety to one hundred twenty minutes of first medical contact, and that clock starts with you. Fibrinolytics are drugs that dissolve the clot but can cause bleeding anywhere; they're not on the BC exam drug list. In the book, an early twelve-lead with early notice cuts fifteen to thirty minutes off treatment, and repeating a normal one before leaving finds ten to fifteen percent more STEMIs. Lesson four covers the twelve-lead.
slides.sayZh: 教材的口号是「时间就是心肌」：血栓堵住动脉越久，能存活的心肌越少。医院有两种方法开通血管。PCI，即用导管上的球囊撑开，如果能在首次医疗接触后九十到一百二十分钟内完成就首选它，而这个计时从你接触病人就开始了。溶栓药能溶解血栓，但可能导致全身任何部位出血，它不在 BC 考试药物清单上。书里说，早做十二导联并提前通知医院，能把治疗时间缩短十五到三十分钟；出发前把正常的十二导联再做一次，能多发现百分之十到十五的 STEMI。十二导联本身在第四课讲。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• ASA: book 160–325 mg → BC 160 mg chewed
  • Nitro: book q5 min, 3–6 doses → BC q3–5 min, max 3 in 30 min
  • Nitro HR limits: book 50–160 → BC 50–150, plus SBP > 110
  • PDE-5: book 24–72 h → BC Viagra/Levitra 24 h, Cialis 48 h
  • Oxygen: book SpO₂ 90–94% → BC ≥ 94%
  • Book's morphine, fentanyl, fibrinolytics: not on the BC exam
slides.say: Let's line up the book and BC. ASA: the book, one hundred sixty to three hundred twenty-five milligrams; BC, one hundred sixty, chewed. Nitro: the book, zero point three or zero point four every five minutes for three to six doses; BC, zero point four every three to five minutes, maximum three in thirty minutes. Heart rate limits: the book, fifty and one hundred sixty; BC, fifty and one hundred fifty, plus a systolic above one hundred ten. For erectile dysfunction drugs, BC uses twenty-four hours for Viagra or Levitra, forty-eight for Cialis. Oxygen: the book, ninety to ninety-four percent; BC, ninety-four or higher. Morphine, fentanyl and fibrinolytics aren't on the BC licensing exam; in BCEHS, morphine and fentanyl are ACP drugs.
slides.sayZh: 把书和 BC 对一对。ASA：书里一百六十到三百二十五毫克；BC 一百六十毫克嚼服。硝酸甘油：书里零点三或零点四毫克，每五分钟一次，共三到六次；BC 零点四毫克，每三到五分钟一次，三十分钟内最多三次。心率界限：书里五十和一百六十；BC 五十和一百五十，外加收缩压高于一百一十。勃起功能障碍药：BC 规定万艾可或艾力达二十四小时、希爱力四十八小时。血氧：书里百分之九十到九十四；BC 九十四或以上。吗啡、芬太尼和溶栓药执照考试都不考；在 BCEHS，吗啡和芬太尼是 ACP 用药。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• IV en route: never hold a chest pain patient for a line
  • Book: avoid the right arm (cath lab uses the right radial)
  • Dimenhydrinate: 1 mg/kg, max 50 mg; IV diluted over 1–2 min
  • Caution: hypertension, ischemic heart disease; can speed the heart
  • Pain gone > 5 min, then back = new episode: nitro again, not ASA
slides.say: Now the watch-outs that are new at your level. First, the IV: the protocol puts transport first, so start the line in the ambulance; never hold the patient on scene for it. The textbook also suggests avoiding the right arm, because the cath lab often goes in through the right radial artery. Second, dimenhydrinate: one milligram per kilogram, up to fifty milligrams; by IV, diluted and given slowly over one to two minutes. BC lists high blood pressure and ischemic heart disease as cautions, and it can speed the heart, so weigh it carefully. Third, pain gone for more than five minutes and then back is a new episode: nitro again, but not ASA.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲 PCP 层面新的注意事项。第一，静脉通路：流程把转运放在前面，所以在救护车上开，别为了开静脉把病人留在现场。教材还建议尽量避开右臂，因为导管室常从右侧桡动脉进入。第二，茶苯海明：每公斤一毫克，最多五十毫克；静脉给药要稀释，一到两分钟缓慢推完。BC 把高血压和缺血性心脏病列为慎用情况，它还可能加快心率，所以要权衡。第三，疼痛完全消失超过五分钟后又出现，算新一轮发作：可以再给硝酸甘油，但不再给 ASA。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Chest pain = ACS until proven otherwise; watch for silent MI
  2. ASA saves lives (160 mg chewed); nitro never delays transport
  3. Nitro stops: SBP < 110; HR < 50 or > 150; Viagra 24 h, Cialis 48 h

Next: heart failure, CPAP, cardiogenic shock and aortic emergencies
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: chest pain is acute coronary syndrome until the hospital proves otherwise, and diabetics, older adults and women may have no chest pain at all. Two: ASA is the life-saving drug, one hundred sixty milligrams, chewed. Nitro relieves pain but doesn't save lives, and never delays transport. As a PCP, you add an IV en route and an anti-nausea option. Three: know nitro's stop signs cold: a systolic under one hundred ten, a heart rate under fifty or over one hundred fifty, Viagra or Levitra within twenty-four hours, Cialis within forty-eight. Next lesson: heart failure, CPAP, cardiogenic shock and aortic emergencies. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，胸痛就是急性冠脉综合征，直到医院排除为止；糖尿病人、老年人和女性可能完全没有胸痛。二，ASA 是救命药，一百六十毫克嚼服；硝酸甘油能止痛但不救命，也绝不能耽误转运；作为 PCP，你多了途中开静脉和止吐药。三，把硝酸甘油的禁忌背熟：收缩压低于一百一十，心率低于五十或高于一百五十，二十四小时内用过万艾可或艾力达，四十八小时内用过希爱力。下节课讲心衰、CPAP、心源性休克和主动脉急症。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
